description: This PHP source file defines the `PurchaseOrder` class, which extends `CRMEntity`. It includes properties, methods, and logic related to managing purchase order records within the vtiger CRM system, including saving, retrieving activities and history, and handling relationships with other modules.

classes.name: PurchaseOrder
classes.description: Represents the Purchase Order entity within the vtiger CRM, handling database interactions, associated activities, history, and relationships with other modules.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Persists changes for a PurchaseOrder, updates product stocks if shipment is received, and updates currency information.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves active tasks related to this purchase order for display in the CRM interface.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Fetches completed or deferred activities associated with the purchase order for historical view.

methods.name: get_postatushistory
methods.description: Retrieves the status change history of the purchase order, including order number, vendor, amount, status, and last modified date.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Constructs a secondary SQL query part for reports involving purchase orders and related modules.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns the relation table and field mappings for related modules such as Calendar, Documents, and Contacts.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes the relationship between this purchase order and another entity, such as Vendors or Contacts.
